If you make a reservation and want to change it during the early access period, you can modify your reservation if space is available. Once the early access period is over, you can’t modify or cancel your reservation until the appropriate on-sale date.

Heading: North Pines Campground Early Access Lottery > What if I’m not available to make a reservation during my time slot?

What if I’m not available to make a reservation during my time slot?

If you miss your time slot, you can make a reservation (if any are available) until the end of the early access period (February 2). Otherwise, you will have to wait until the next general on-sale date.

candidates.text:
Heading: North Pines Campground Early Access Lottery > How can I increase my odds of success during the early access period?

How can I increase my odds of success during the early access period?

You will be able to view availability starting January 2, but will not be able to make a reservation until your time slot begins. Be sure to check availability before your time slot begins so you can adjust your dates or sites accordingly. Being awarded an early access time slot does not guarantee you will get a reservation of your choice. Reservations will still be in high demand.

Heading: North Pines Campground Early Access Lottery > What if I’m not available to make a reservation during my time slot?

What if I’m not available to make a reservation during my time slot?

If you miss your time slot, you can make a reservation (if any are available) until the end of the early access period (February 2). Otherwise, you will have to wait until the next general on-sale date.

Heading: North Pines Campground Early Access Lottery > How can I increase my odds of success during the early access period?

How can I increase my odds of success during the early access period?

You will be able to view availability starting January 2, but will not be able to make a reservation until your time slot begins. Be sure to check availability before your time slot begins so you can adjust your dates or sites accordingly. Being awarded an early access time slot does not guarantee you will get a reservation of your choice. Reservations will still be in high demand.
